description: The source tags every entry in content/hero-tables resolves to. A hero records the tags of the sources it uses, and a table can see them. A licensed pack, if the owner ever obtains a written licence, would be declared here as a new tag; none is declared today and no Player's Handbook content is present.

sources.ruleset_note: Adds no rule, feat, feature, item or coin. Backgrounds use only the SRD background template (three ability scores, one SRD Origin feat, two skills, one tool, equipment worth 50 GP or 50 GP). Story cards, trades and callings are presentation aids that spend only the free choices of the standard build. See planning/generated-content.md for the disclosed, versioned custom-content rule.
